about_the_game:
Many moons ago, mysterious guardians known as the Cloudwalkers kept watch over the cloud world above Earth. As a dark force stirs, only one remains to protect the skies from an alien invasion.

Cloudwalkers is a hilarious action-packed shooter-platformer set in the clouds above Earth. Strange invaders called the Alens are swarming the cloud world, and it’s up to you to outsmart them.

You’ll start with your trusty blaster, but as you progress you’ll unlock powerful new moves like the slam pound, roll, and more. Each ability expands how you fight and explore, letting you reach new heights and face tougher challenges.

Key Features

☁️ Platforming in the skies – run, jump, and dash across the clouds..

👽 Battle the Alens – quirky and mysterious alien invaders with plenty of tricks.

🔓 Unlock new abilities – master the slam pound, roll, and other upgrades to evolve your playstyle.

🌎 Explore multiple worlds – each one introduces unique obstacles and surprises.

😂 Lighthearted fun – fast, energetic gameplay with a humorous tone.

Will you rise to the challenge and save the skies, or will the Alens take over the clouds?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Ryzen 5500 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 / AMD Radeon R5 / NVIDIA GeForce 300 series or better
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: (Requirements are currently the minimum tested. They may be lowered later.)

short_description: Cloudwalkers is a hilarious third-person shooter-platformer where you defend the cloud world from quirky alien invaders.
